description: Anchored floating panel rendered with popover="manual" and opened via the HTML Popover API, placing it in the browser top layer — above every z-index stacking context and outside every ancestor's overflow/transform clipping. overlay.js positions it against an anchor element with placement/alignment, viewport-edge flipping and shifting, scroll/resize tracking, Escape and outside-pointerdown dismissal, and a fixed-position fallback (data-tm-overlay-fallback) where the Popover API is missing. Shared primitive behind TmPopover, TmDropdown, TmContextMenu, TmSplitButton, TmDatePicker, TmDateRangePicker, TmDateTimePicker, TmMultiSelect, TmTagPicker, TmEntityPicker, TmFilterableDropdown, TmNotificationBell, TmColorPicker, TmMultiColumnComboBox and TmQueryInput popups.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: Id of the rendered panel element. Defaults to a generated value; supply one when the anchor should reference it (e.g. via aria-controls).

parameters.name: Anchor
parameters.description: The element the panel positions itself against. When unset, overlay.js falls back to the panel's previous element sibling — the natural trigger-then-panel layout.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.description: Preferred side of the anchor the panel opens on (Bottom, Top, Left, Right).

parameters.name: Align
parameters.description: Cross-axis alignment against the anchor (Start, Center, End).

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Gap in pixels between anchor and panel on the resolved side.

parameters.name: ViewportMargin
parameters.description: Minimum distance in pixels the panel keeps from the viewport edges.

parameters.name: Flip
parameters.description: Flip to the opposite side when the preferred side does not have enough room.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: Slide the panel along the cross axis so it stays inside the viewport.

parameters.name: MatchAnchorWidth
parameters.description: Stretch the panel to the anchor's width (dropdown/select menus).

parameters.name: ConstrainHeight
parameters.description: Cap the panel height at the room available on the resolved side (honouring a smaller CSS max-height) and let it scroll.

parameters.name: CloseOnEscape
parameters.description: Close when Escape is pressed while the panel is open; focus returns to the anchor.

parameters.name: CloseOnOutsidePointerDown
parameters.description: Close when a pointerdown lands outside both the panel and the anchor.

parameters.name: IsOpen
parameters.description: Controlled open state. When null the panel tracks its own internal state.

parameters.name: IsOpenChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the open state should change (two-way bindable).

parameters.name: OnDismissed
parameters.description: Fires when the panel is dismissed by a user gesture rather than by the consumer: "escape" or "outside". Programmatic closes do not raise it.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description: ARIA role of the panel — typically menu, listbox, dialog or tooltip.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.description: Panel content. Rendered only while the panel is open.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) for the panel element — components pass their own panel class here.
